item.title: U18 REACTION | 'There were lots of opportunities to learn'
item.description: Professional Development Phase Lead Coach Craig Knight believed there were plenty of learning opportunities for his Under-18s side after they narrowly lost 2-1 away to Carlisle United. item.title: REPORT | Bristol City 2-2 Wrexham AFC
item.description: Ollie Rathbone scored his sixth goal of the season as Wrexham drew away to Bristol City at Ashton Gate. Rathbone gave Wrexham a deserved half-time lead, but the Robins shuffled their pack at the interval and hit back immediately through Sinclair Armstrong. Joe Williams put through his own net to give Wrexham the lead again, but Max Bird volleyed in a brilliant equaliser to snatch a point. item.title: GALLERY | Bristol City 2-2 Wrexham AFC
item.description: Wrexham AFC were held to a draw as Bristol City found a late equaliser to share the points on Shrove Tuesday. Nathan Broadhead, Ben Sheaf and Issa Kaboré returned to the starting line-up as Wrexham made three changes to the team which started the win against Ipswich Town the previous Friday. item.title: COMMUNITY | Academy scholars visit Wrexham Foodbank ahead of food drive at Ipswich game
item.description: Academy scholars Nikolas Slosarczyk and Daymeon Almeida recently visited the Wrexham Foodbank, ahead of our food drive at Saturday's Ipswich game. Recently, both scholars took a tour of the Foodbank to learn more about its importance to the local community and how the Club are supporting families in need as part of our wider child poverty campaign.
